Management

The management of Rosenbauer International AG is in the hands of an experienced team with a clear vision and comprehensive industry expertise.

Learn more
what defines us

Leadership with vision and innovation

As the world's leading provider of firefighting technology, we are shaping the future of the industry: with sustainable solutions, state-of-the-art technology and a clear commitment to quality. Our managers combine many years of industry experience with a deep understanding of global markets and technological developments. They provide decisive impetus for growth, digitalisation and increased efficiency - always with the target of offering our clients worldwide the best equipment and the best service.

Leadership with vision – our board of directors shapes the future of Rosenbauer

Our drive

Leadership for the future

Rosenbauer is actively committed to the further development of firefighting technology – with innovative products, digital solutions and a clear vision for the future. Our leaders stand for responsibility, efficiency and the tireless drive to provide the best solutions for our clients worldwide.
